headline: Cybernews reports that the recent supermarket refrigeration hack in Europe was recreated with an AI tool for about $6 in 28 minutes.
score_reason: Kept at pool score 5: the underlying attack is widely reported, but the AI-recreation claim is from one article we could not open.
importance_line: Operators of industrial and retail control systems may find such attacks cheaper to copy than expected, but we have not seen the method or who did the test.
summary: Cybernews reports in its headline that the supermarket refrigeration hack was recreated with AI for $6 in 28 minutes, a claim we could not check against the full article.
notes: Headline only; page blocked (HTTP 403). The fridge attack itself dates from 11-12 Oct 2026.
